companyId.description: Ivo Systems company id that this division belongs to

divisionDescription.description: Company description for the division if applicable

createdTimestampUtc.description: Utc timestamp generated when the division was created

createdByUserId.description: Ivo Systems user id that created the division - default 45 (IVO Systems User)

isDeleted.description: Boolean flag indicating if the division has been deleted in either system

deletedTimestampUtc.description: Utc timestamp of time of deletion

deletedByUserId.description: Ivo Systems user id that deleted the division

updatedTimestampUtc.description: Utc timestamp of time of last update

updatedByUserId.description: Ivo Systems user id that last updated the division
